messages:
Maya Patel: Heads-up — Acme just escalated: after last night's v3.4.0 rollout their invoice assistant stopped calling the get_invoice tool reliably. Some calls are missing, others return with swapped or truncated args.

Acme Support: FYI here's a failing example from prod (request id: r-0a1b2c3d):
```curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \n -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' \n -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n -d '{\n  "model":"redwood-chat-*-v2",\n  "messages":[{\n    "role":"user",\n    "content":"Fetch my invoice for Feb 2026 for customer 123"\n  }],\n  "tools":[{\n    "name":"get_invoice",\n    "schema":{\n      "customer_id":"string",\n      "invoice_month":"string"\n    }\n  }]\n}'```

Acme Support: The assistant returned a completion instead of invoking the tool, and in the few tool calls that happened the payload looked like `{\"customer\":\"123\",\"month\":\"02-2026\"}` which our backend rejects.

Jonah Kim: Thanks — does this reproduce on staging? Any correlation with canary nodes? Also paste the raw completion (with tool call metadata) if available.

Acme Support: Repro on prod only so far. We spun up a local repro using the same request id and saw identical behavior. Raw completion (trimmed): `{"choices":[{"message":{"content":"call_tool","tool_call":{"name":"get_invoice","arguments":"{\"customer\":\"123\",\"month\":\"02-2026\"}"}}}]}`

Maya Patel: That looks like the argument shape changed (customer/month) vs schema (customer_id/invoice_month). Could be a serialization change in the tool-calling logic introduced in v3.4.0. SupportBot: Incident created #INC-2026-479.

Eve Ramos: I pulled canary logs from last night — there was a small change to the tool-call encoder to handle single-quoted JSON. It introduced a fallback codepath that flattens nested keys when an internal proto flag is set. Rolling that out to canary at 02:12 UTC.

Jonah Kim: Can we confirm which model binary was pushed? Any model variant that toggles 'tool_call_compat=v2'?

Eve Ramos: Model build redwood-chat-3.4.0-alpha+deploy used runtime flag tool_call_compat=true. The legacy schema expects the previous key names, so when the encoder falls back it rewrites keys (customer -> customer_id, month -> invoice_month) incorrectly in some codepaths and in others it serializes arguments as a string rather than JSON blob, causing the assistant to not be recognized as a tool invocation by the router.

Maya Patel: Immediate mitigation: 1) Route Acme to model redwood-chat-3.3.2 (pre-rollout) by pinning customer in the routing table. 2) Roll back the encoder change on canary and pause the v3.4.0 rollout.

Jonah Kim: On it — I'll create a routing override and add a per-customer pin. ETA 10m.

Jonah Kim: Routing override applied for Acme (routes->pins: acme_corp -> redwood-chat-3.3.2). Please confirm.

Acme Support: Confirmed — their requests are invoking get_invoice again and payload matches schema. They report fewer errors. :relieved:

Eve Ramos: I've opened an internal PR to revert the encoder fallback and add unit tests for nested tool arg shapes + end-to-end integration tests that validate tool_call metadata isn't stringified. PR: github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4121

Maya Patel: Nice. For postmortem: we need a checklist — model-level feature flags should require a compatibility gate and a rollout smoke test that exercises tool-call contracts with a sample tooling schema. Also add monitoring alert: if tool_call count drops >20% for a customer after a deploy, auto-signal SRE.

SupportBot: Next steps logged in #INC-2026-479: rollback scheduled, customer pinned, PR opened, postmortem owner assigned (Jonah).

Jonah Kim: Assigning postmortem owner now. I'll write the timeline and include the reproducer and request id.

Maya Patel: Thanks team. Acme will be looped in with a status update.

Acme Support: Thanks for the quick action — they'll be watching.

Jonah Kim: Follow-up: temporary mitigation validated. Will monitor 1h and then approve canary when tests pass.

Eve Ramos: Logged a long-term action item to add serializer fuzzing in CI for tool schemas.

Maya Patel: Closing thread for now; reopen if errors recur. :white_check_mark:
